l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Haddii a=2,b=3, bidix 25, midig 13; ma sinna. Da’awadu waa khalad.

l-m-m2-b0s5-01.title: Shin jimillar furuci biyu masu murabba’i koyaushe furuci mai murabba’i ne?
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.goal: Bincika ko ikirarin cewa jimillar furuci biyu masu murabba’i koyaushe furuci mai murabba’i ne gaskiya ne, sannan nemo ka bayyana yanayin da ba haka ba (misalin karyatawa).
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.material: Ikirari: Idan aka ƙara furuci biyu masu murabba’i, jimillarsu ma koyaushe furuci ne mai murabba’i. (Furuci mai murabba’i shi ne mai mafi girman ma’aunin 2, misali x²+3x.) Nemo ƙari da ke nuna wannan ikirari ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.a: Jimillar 3x²−x+1 ma furuci ne mai murabba’i. Misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.b: Jimillar 4x²−x+5 ma furuci ne mai murabba’i. Misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.d: Jimillar 2x²+2x+3 ma furuci ne mai murabba’i. Misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.explain: (x²+4x)+(−x²+2)=4x+2. Kalmar x² ta soke juna, sakamakon kuma furuci ne na layi, saboda haka jimillar ba furuci mai murabba’i ba ce.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s2.model.0: Ƙara x² da −x² yana ba da 0, suna ɓacewa, saboda haka jimillar 4x+2 furuci ne na layi. Wannan ya zama misalin karyatawa.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s2.model.1: A cikin (x²+4x)+(−x²+2), kalmomin x² sun tara zuwa 0, suna ba da 4x+2, saboda haka ba furuci mai murabba’i ba ne.

l-m-m2-b02-31.title: Ƙa’idar murabba’in hypotenuse na alwatika mai kusurwa dama mai gefuna biyu daidai
l-m-m2-b02-31.goal: Nemo ka bayyana ƙa’ida daga misalai da dama na alwatika mai kusurwa dama wadda gefunanta biyu da ke kewaye da kusurwar dama suke daidai, sannan ka gwada ƙa’idar a sabon misali.
l-m-m2-b02-31.material: A cikin alwatika mai kusurwa dama wadda gefunanta biyu kusa da kusurwar dama suke daidai, idan waɗannan gefuna su ne 1, 2, 3, 4, to (tsawon hypotenuse)² su ne 2, 8, 18, 32 bi da bi. Nemo ƙa’idar.
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s1.prompt: Idan gefunan kusa da kusurwar dama su ne 5, mene ne (tsawon hypotenuse)²?
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s1.r.a: Ka tara gefunan, kamar 5+5. Murabba’in hypotenuse shi ne jimillar murabba’in gefunan.
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s1.r.b: Ka rubuta 5² kawai. Dole ne a tara murabba’in gefuna biyun da ke kewaye da kusurwar dama.
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s1.r.d: Wannan 10² ne. Ka fara tara gefunan sannan ka yi murabba’i.
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s1.explain: (hypotenuse)²=a²+a²=2a². Idan a=1→2, 2→8, 3→18, 4→32, kuma idan a=5 ya zama 50.
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s2.model.0: Ƙimomin hypotenuse² 2, 8, 18, 32 su ne sau 2 na side² (2×1², 2×2², 2×3², 2×4²). Don haka idan gefen 5 ne, 2×25=50.
l-m-m2-b02-31.s.s2.model.1: Gefuna biyun da ke kewaye da kusurwar dama daidai suke, saboda haka hypotenuse²=5²+5²=50. Wannan ya dace da ƙa’idar ninka da 2 daga misalan, saboda haka daidai ne.

l-m-m2-b03-16.material: Warwarewar (x, y) na lissafin layi 2x+3y=18 sun haɗa da (0, 6), (3, 4), da (6, 2). Nemo tsarin canjin x idan y yana raguwa.
l-m-m2-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Idan y ya ragu da 2, x yana ƙaruwa da 3. Ba ya ƙaruwa da 2.
l-m-m2-b03-16.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi amfani da “x yana ƙaruwa da 3” sau huɗu. y yana raguwa daga 6 zuwa 0 a matakai uku.

l-m-m2-b03-16.s.s1.explain: Kowace rana idan y ya ragu da 2, x yana ƙaruwa da 3. y yana sauka daga 6 zuwa 0 a matakai 3, saboda haka x=0+9=9.
l-m-m2-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: Kowace rana idan y ya ragu da 2, x yana ƙaruwa da 3. Tun da y yana raguwa sau 3 daga 6 zuwa 0, x=3×3=9.
l-m-m2-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: Saka y=0 cikin 2x+3y=18 yana ba da 2x=18, don haka x=9, wanda ya dace da tsarin misalan.

l-m-m2-b04-28.goal: Ka ƙiyasta zangon x inda lissafan biyu suke haɗuwa, zaɓi adadi ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-m2-b04-28.material: Ka ƙiyasta inda mafitar tsarin y=2x−1, y=−x+7 take. A x=2 ƙimomin su ne 3 da 5; a x=3 kuma su ne 5 da 4.
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s1.prompt: A cikin wane zangon ne x yake sa maganganun biyu su yi daidai?
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s1.r.a: A x=3, maganar farko ta riga ta fi girma, saboda haka sun riga sun haɗu.
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Tsari ya sauya a x=3, don haka mafitar ba ta kai 4 ba.
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: Ko a x=2, maganar farko har yanzu ta fi ƙanƙanta, saboda haka ba su haɗu ba tukuna.
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s1.explain: A x=2 maganar farko ta fi ƙanƙanta, a x=3 kuma ta fi girma. Suna haɗuwa a tsakaninsu.
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s2.model.0: A x=2 ƙimar magana ta farko ta fi ƙanƙanta, a x=3 kuma ta fi girma, saboda haka suna daidaita a tsakaninsu.
l-m-m2-b04-28.s.s2.model.1: Tsarin girman maganganun biyu yana sauyawa tsakanin 2 da 3, saboda haka wurin haɗuwarsu yana tsakanin 2 da 3.

l-m-m2-b04-36.title: Kimanin tsawon hypotenuse nawa ne?
l-m-m2-b04-36.goal: Kimanta tsawon hypotenuse na alwatika mai kusurwa dama; zaɓi girma ko kewayo da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-m2-b04-36.material: Akwai alwatika mai kusurwa dama wadda gefuna biyu da ke kewaye da kusurwar dama su ne 4 da 5. Kimanta tsawon hypotenuse. 6²=36 kuma 7²=49.
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s1.prompt: Wane tsawo ne ya fi dacewa ga hypotenuse?
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s1.r.a: Ka ninka gefunan biyu. Hypotenuse ba samfurinsu ba ne.
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s1.r.b: Wannan jimillar murabba’i ne. Tsawon shi ne tushen murabba’inta.
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s1.r.d: Wannan jimillar gefunan biyun ne. Hypotenuse ya fi jimillar gefunan biyu gajarta.
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s1.explain: Hypotenuse²=16+25=41 kuma 36<41<49, saboda haka hypotenuse yana tsakanin 6 da 7, kusan 6.4.
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s2.model.0: Hypotenuse²=41 yana tsakanin 6²=36 da 7²=49, saboda haka hypotenuse yana tsakanin 6 da 7, kusan 6.4.
l-m-m2-b04-36.s.s2.model.1: 41 ya ɗan fi 36 girma, saboda haka ya kamata ya ɗan fi 6 girma, kuma kusan 6.4 ya dace.

l-m-m2-b05-16.title: Kusan nawa ne 2³⁰?
l-m-m2-b05-16.goal: Kimanta girman 2³⁰ don zaɓar girma ko kewayo da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-m2-b05-16.material: 2¹⁰=1024 kusan 1000 ne. Yi amfani da wannan don kimanta kusan 2³⁰.
l-m-m2-b05-16.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙima ce ta fi kusa da 2³⁰?
l-m-m2-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: Tiriliyan 1 kusan 2⁴⁰ ne. Ma’aunin ƙarfin ya yi ƙasa da 10.
l-m-m2-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: 100 × 10,000 (miliyan 1) kusan 2²⁰ ne. Ma’aunin ƙarfin ya fi girma da 10.

l-m-m2-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: Ninka 1000 sau uku yana ba da miliyan ɗari 10 (biliyan 1), saboda haka 2³⁰ ma kusan miliyan ɗari 10 ne (biliyan 1).

l-m-m2-b03-39.goal: Bi matakan warware yiwuwar samun aƙalla 6 guda ɗaya idan aka jefa lido sau biyu, ko jerin dalili da sakamako, sannan nemo ka gyara wurin farko da aka yi kuskure.

l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.r.a: Shirin nemo aukuwar kishiya da farko daidai ne.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.r.b: Fuskoki 5 ba 6 ba ne, don haka 5/6 ne.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.r.c: An ninka jifa biyun don samun 25/36, saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s1.explain: Don “aƙalla sau ɗaya”, a cire yiwuwar rashin faruwarsa ko kaɗan daga 1. 1−25/36=11/36.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s2.model.0: A ④, ba a yi amfani da shirin ① ba kuma an ƙara 1/6. 1−25/36=11/36 daidai ne, kuma ya bambanta da 1/3=12/36, saboda haka an yi kuskure.
l-m-m2-b03-39.s.s2.model.1: Yanayin samun 6 sau biyu sun yi karo da juna, saboda haka kada a tara. Cire 25/36 daga 1 yana ba da 11/36.

l-m-m2-b04-22.s.s1.r.c: Ka rubuta 4 a matsayin ma'aunin ƙarfi, sannan ka ninka 8 sau huɗu.
l-m-m2-b04-22.s.s2.model.0: 2³×2² yana tara ma'aunin ƙarfin ya zama 2⁵=32, don haka yana da ma'ana iri ɗaya da 8×4=32.
l-m-m2-b04-22.s.s2.model.1: Ana ninka 2 sau 3 da sau 2, jimilla sau 5, wato 2⁵.

l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s1.r.a: Dusheedu waxay gaadhaa joog ku dhowaad 10.9m oo keliya, daaqadda ma gaadho.

l-m-m2-b01-32.s.s2.model.0: Salka jaranjaradu 5m derbiga ka fog yahay; si ay 12m u gaadho dhererku √(5²+12²)=13m. 12m gaadhi ma karto, 13m ayaa ugu gaaban.

l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.r.a: Suurtagalnimadu 40% oo shuruud buuxisa, laakiin dhibcaheedu way ka yar yihiin D.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.r.b: Yiwuwar ta 30% ce, ta kasa cika 40%.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.o.c: C: Masu nasara 5 cikin 10, lada maki 2
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.r.c: Yiwuwar ta 50% ce, saboda haka ta cika sharaɗin, amma makinta ya fi na D ƙasa.

l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s1.explain: Akwatunan da yiwuwarsu ta kai 40% ko fiye su ne A (40%), C (50%), da D (kimanin 41.7%). A cikinsu, D ce ke da maki mafi yawa.
l-m-m2-b01-36.s.s2.model.0: Yiwuwar A ita ce 2/5=40%, ta B ita ce 3/10=30%, ta C ita ce 1/2, ta D kuma ita ce 5/12, kimanin 41.7%. B ba ta kai 40% ba, saboda haka a cire ta.

l-m-m2-b02-04.title: Wane murabba’i ne ke da fili mafi girma idan zagayensa bai wuce 20 cm ba?
l-m-m2-b02-04.goal: Auna duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna game da tsawo da faɗin murabba’i, zaɓi matsaya mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m2-b02-04.material: Za a yi murabba’i mai tsawon da ya fi faɗinsa da 2 cm. Zagayensa dole ne ya zama 20 cm ko ƙasa da haka, kuma ana son filinsa ya zama mafi girma gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.prompt: Wane tsari ne ya cika dukkan sharuɗɗan kuma yake da fili mafi girma?
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma akwai tsari mai fili da ya fi 15 cm² girma.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.r.b: Zagayen 24 cm ne, wanda ya wuce 20 cm.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.r.d: Tsawon ya fi faɗin da 1 cm kawai, wanda ya karya sharaɗin 2 cm.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s1.explain: Idan faɗi x ne kuma tsawo x+2, zagaye shi ne 4x+4≤20, saboda haka x≤4. Idan x=4, fili 24 cm² ne, mafi girma.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s2.model.0: Idan faɗi 4 ne kuma tsawo 6, zagaye shi ne 2×(4+6)=20, saboda haka ya cika sharaɗin, kuma tsawon ya fi faɗin da 2. Filin 24 ne, mafi girma.
l-m-m2-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: (5, 7) yana da zagaye 24, saboda haka a cire shi, kuma (4, 5) bambancinsa 1 ne. (3, 5) yana da fili 15, ƙasa da 24 na (4, 6), saboda haka (4, 6) shi ne zaɓi daidai.

l-m-m2-b02-12.title: Tafiya cikin mintuna 90 yayin tafiya gwargwadon yiwuwa
l-m-m2-b02-12.goal: Yi la'akari da duk yanayin rikice-rikice a cikin yanke shawarar nisan tafiya, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, kuma bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m2-b02-12.material: Kuna zuwa wani wuri mai nisan kilomita 12 daga gida. Yin tafiya yana 4 km / h kuma keke shine 12 km / h. Dole ne ku isa cikin mintuna 90, kuma kuna son yin tafiya gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Wane shiri ne ya cika sharuɗɗan kuma ya fi tafiya?

l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Idan nisan tafiya ya kasance x km, to x/4+(12−x)/12≤1.5, wato x≤3. Idan x=3, yana ɗaukar mintuna 90 daidai.
l-m-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Tafiya kilomita 3 da hawan keke na kilomita 9 yana ɗaukar minti 45+45 = minti 90, don haka ya dace da yanayin lokaci. kilomita 4 yana ɗaukar mintuna 100, wanda ya wuce mintuna 90, don haka kilomita 3 shine matsakaicin.

l-m-m2-b02-16.title: Shirya abubuwa 36 cikin manya da kanana kwalaye
l-m-m2-b02-16.goal: Yi la'akari da duk yanayi masu karo da juna wajen yanke shawarar adadin akwatuna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, kuma bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m2-b02-16.material: Babban akwati yana riƙe da abubuwa 6 kuma ƙaramin akwati yana riƙe da 4. Dole ne ku tattara dukkan abubuwa 36 ba tare da sauran ba, kuma kuna iya amfani da aƙalla manyan akwatuna 4. Kuna so ku yi amfani da ƴan kwalaye kamar yadda zai yiwu.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.prompt: Wane shiri ne ya dace da duk sharuɗɗan tare da ƙananan kwalaye?
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Yana karya yanayin amfani da manyan akwatuna 4.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.r.b: Ya cika sharuddan, amma yana amfani da akwatuna 8, fiye da tsarin da 7.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Ya cika sharuddan, amma yana amfani da akwatuna 9, mafi yawa.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s1.explain: Daga cikin tsare-tsaren da ke da 6x+4y=36 da x≤4, wanda ke da ‘yan kwalaye x+y shine (4, 3), wato kwalaye 7.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Manyan akwatuna 4 suna ɗauke da abubuwa 24 da ƙananan kwalaye 3 suna riƙe da 12, waɗanda ke ɗauke da duka 36. Yana amfani da akwatuna 7, mafi ƙanƙanta a cikin tsare-tsaren da suka cika sharuddan.
l-m-m2-b02-16.s.s2.model.1: Manyan akwatuna 6 sun karya iyakar 4, don haka sun fita. (2, 6) yana amfani da 8 da (0, 9) yana amfani da 9, don haka (4, 3) tare da akwatuna 7 shine mafi ƙanƙanta.

l-m-m2-b03-15.title: Mafi yawan mutane nawa za su iya shiga idan rangwamen rukuni ya shafa kuma kuɗin bai wuce 70000 won ba?
l-m-m2-b03-15.goal: Lokacin yanke shawarar mutane nawa za su iya shiga, auna duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa, zaɓi matsaya mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m2-b03-15.material: Kuɗin shiga na mutum 1 shi ne 8000 won, amma idan mutane 10 ko fiye ne, kuɗin mutum 1 ya zama 6500 won. Ƙungiyar tana son mutane da yawa su shiga gwargwadon iko, jimillar kuɗi kuma ta zama 70000 won ko ƙasa da haka.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s1.prompt: Mafi yawan mutane nawa za su iya shiga yayin bin sharuɗɗan?
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s1.r.a: Kuɗin 64000 won ne kuma ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma mutane da yawa za su iya zuwa.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Mutane 9 ba sa samun rangwame, saboda haka kuɗin 72000 won ne, amma mutane 10 suna biyan 6500 won kowannensu, jimilla 65000 won. Mutane 11 suna kashe 71500 won, wanda ya wuce.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s2.model.0: Ga mutane 10, kuɗin rukuni yana ba da 10×6500=65000 won, wanda bai wuce 70000 won ba. Mutane 11 suna biyan 71500 won, wanda ya wuce, saboda haka 10 ne mafi yawa.
l-m-m2-b03-15.s.s2.model.1: Mutane 9 suna kashe 72000 won, wanda ya wuce, amma daga mutane 10 farashin ya ragu. Don haka mafi yawan mutanen da za su iya shiga bisa sharuɗɗan su ne 10.

l-m-m2-b03-40.goal: Lokacin yanke shawarar adadin waɗanda za a zaɓa, auna duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa, zaɓi matsaya mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m2-b03-40.material: Adadin hanyoyin zaɓar mutane 3 daga cikin n sannan a jera su dole ne ya kai 100 ko fiye. Ana son adadin ’yan takara n ya zama mafi ƙanƙanta gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s1.prompt: Mafi ƙarancin adadin mutane nawa ne ya cika dukkan sharuɗɗan?
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s1.r.c: Hanyoyi 7×6×5=210 ya cika sharaɗin, amma mutane 6 sun fi ƙanƙanta.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s1.explain: Hanyoyi 6×5×4=120, sun kai 100 ko fiye, kuma wannan shi ne mafi ƙarancin adadin mutane cikin zaɓuɓɓukan.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s2.model.0: Da mutane 6, hanyoyi 6×5×4=120 ne, sun kai 100 ko fiye. Mutane 5 suna ba da 60, bai isa ba, saboda haka 6 ne mafi ƙanƙanta.
l-m-m2-b03-40.s.s2.model.1: Yayin da adadin mutane yake ƙaruwa, adadin hanyoyi ma yana ƙaruwa; saboda haka ana buƙatar adadin mutane wanda ya fara wuce 100. Mutane 5 suna ba da 60, 6 kuma suna ba da 120, saboda haka 6 ne.

l-m-m2-b04-08.goal: Don sayen kayan ciye-ciye na rukuni, yi la’akari da duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa, zaɓi matsaya mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m2-b04-08.material: Jakar kayan ciye-ciye tana kashe 1500 won, kwalbar abin sha kuma 2000 won. Kasafin kuɗi bai wuce 20000 won ba, ana buƙatar aƙalla abin sha 3, kuma ana son sayen abubuwa da yawa gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane tsari ne ya kiyaye duk sharuɗɗan kuma ya sayi mafi yawa?

l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.r.c: Kuɗin 20000 won ne, amma abin sha bai kai 3 ba.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.r.d: Zai yiwu da 19000 won, amma abubuwan da aka saya sun yi ƙasa, guda 11 kawai.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s1.explain: 9×1500+3×2000=19500 won, kuma an sayi abubuwa 12. Sauran tsare-tsaren sun karya sharaɗi ko sun sayi ƙasa.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s2.model.0: Kuɗin 19500 won ne, cikin kasafi, kuma akwai abin sha 3, don haka wannan tsarin mai abubuwa 12 ne mafi dacewa.
l-m-m2-b04-08.s.s2.model.1: A sayi abin sha 3 kawai, mafi ƙarancin da aka yarda, a kashe sauran kuɗin a kayan ciye-ciye masu rahusa, saboda haka abubuwa 12 ne mafi yawa.

l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Daga 100−4x≥40, x≤15. Bayan mintuna 15, lita 40 daidai ne suka rage.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: 100−4x≥40, don haka x≤15, kuma mafi tsawon lokacin amfani mintuna 15 ne.
l-m-m2-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: Bayan mintuna 15, lita 40 sun rage; wannan shi ne lokaci mafi tsawo da har yanzu yake cika sharaɗin.
